shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stela
horizontal register-like bands dividing the surface
figures arranged in vertical stacked zones
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing low-relief figural imagery divided into stacked horizontal registers, with rows of small repeated signs and animal/anthropomorphic figures in profile, which gives a loose compositional resemblance. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows elaborately costumed human figures with dense glyph-like columns and ornate headdress detail, while B shows isolated schematic animals (a quadruped, a long-necked bird, a scorpion-like creature) and abstract bands with no human costume or script-like blocks.
